messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a big uptick in KMS decrypt alerts from CI runners starting ~10:10Z. ~350 alerts last 30m, most low-confidence. Filing here before I start muting anything. :eyes:

alex: Can you paste the query / rule that fired?

maria: Query from SIEM: ```kql
index=cloud.audit event=kms.decrypt status=403 OR status=Retry
| stats count() by service_account, src_ip, resource, status
| sort -count
```

maria: The rule uses a 1m window and counts >= 5 to alert. Many events look like retry loops from ephemeral CI workers.

luisa: If these are retries from CI, they're likely noisy. Do we correlate with infra deploys?

maria: Checked deploy board — no big deploys in that window. But the runner pool did autoscale around the same time.

samir: If it's autoscaling, new runners might be hitting KMS before instance metadata is fully provisioned -> transient 403s. We had similar last year.

jordan: Suggestion: suppress alerts for service_accounts matching ci-runner-* and add a one-hour suppression with a high threshold for now. Also add dedupe by src_instance_id.

alex: Rather than blanket suppress, can we adjust the rule to require failure rate >= 20% over 5m for the same service_account? That will keep genuine spikes but ignore noisy retries.

maria: I like that. Proposed rule tweak (pseudo): ```yaml
- name: kms-decrypt-high-failure-rate
  window: 5m
  group_by: service_account
  condition: failure_rate(service_account) > 0.2 AND count > 20
  suppress_exceptions: ["service_account:ci-runner-*", "environment:staging-temp"]
```

sec-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2023-8492 (auto) — SIEM>KMS decrypt alerts. Assigned to @maria.

maria: I'll own the quick fix — will lower alert sensitivity and add the CI runner exception. Also creating a playbook check for "ephemeral runner bootstrap failures".

luisa: Can you also add a dashboard panel that shows failure_rate by service_account and src_instance_id so we can quickly triage next time?

maria: Yep — adding a stacked bar and a heatmap. Will link in the ticket.

samir: Post-incident action: engineering should add jitter/retry-backoff to the bootstrap script to avoid tight retry loops that hammer KMS. I'll create a GH issue and tag infra.

jordan: Also recommend adding a KMS call cache for bootstrap tokens where safe (TTL 5m) to reduce load. Put in eng-runtime backlog.

alex: For now, action items: 1) Update rule to 5m failure_rate >20% + count>20 (maria) 2) Add CI service_account suppression for transient alerts (maria) 3) Dashboard panels (maria) 4) Infra GH issue for backoff/jitter (samir) 5) Follow-up eval in 48h (all)

maria: Working on rule change now. I'll post the SIEM query diff when done. ETA 25m.

luisa: Thanks. Also please cc compliance for audit logging changes — if we suppress alerts we need to document rationale (audit trail).

maria: Good call — adding a note to INC-2023-8492 and pinging compliance.

samir: If anyone sees sustained failures after suppression, escalate immediately.

jordan: :thumbsup:

maria: Update 15m: pushed rule change to staging SIEM (named kms-decrypt-freq-adjust). Alert volume dropped ~90% in staging test. Rolling to prod in 5.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2023-8492 updated — status: monitoring.

maria: Prod change deployed. I'll keep watch for 1h then close. Creating post-incident action items in the ticket now.

alex: Nicely handled. Please add the rule diff and rationale to the ticket so compliance can review.

maria: Will do. Closing this thread for now but will post outcome in the ticket.
